description: Customer Connections Profile - Census Area is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Customer Connections Profile - Census Area " data table provides summary information on the number of import and export customers, by connection voltage and customer type, at Census Zone level (Datazones in Scotland, Output Areas in England & Wales). Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Asset Data. Its keywords are Customer, Connections, Substation, Demand, SPD, SPM. The portal shows 2026-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
